links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of LLM-generated palliative care consultation summaries
links.effect: Grade levels ranged from 10.7 (LLaMA 70B) to 15.2 (GPT-3.5) versus a reference of 10.6; LLaMA 7B 11.9, LLaMA 13B 12.6, GPT-4 13.1.
links.quote: GPT-3.5's summaries were the most complex at a grade level of 15.2, while GPT-4's summaries had a grade level of 13.1, making them moderately accessible.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of various LLMs (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, LLaMA-2) on zero-shot summarization of a simulated palliative care teleconsultation using automated metrics and readability scores, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
